markets.question: Will Hsieh Lung-chieh win the next Tainan Mayor election?
markets.rules:
Taiwanese local elections are scheduled to be held on November 28, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who becomes the next Mayor of Tainan as a result of this election.

Temporary, interim, or placeholder Mayors appointed before the election will not be considered.

If the result of this election isn't known, or no candidate has been elected, by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, the market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the results of the elections as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Taiwanese government, specifically the Central Election Commission (https://db.cec.gov.tw/).

markets.rules:

markets.question: CPI in November — Above -0.2%
markets.rules: If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases by more than -0.2% (single-decimal) in November 2026, then the market resolves to Yes. The market will always close at 8:29 AM ET on the scheduled day of the data release (December 10, 2026). Please note: the Expiration Value is the single-decimal value published at the Source Agency. In the case of a delay in data caused by a federal government shutdown impacting the reliability of the Source Agency, the market’s latest Expiration Date will be extended to the sooner of the release of the Underlying or six months after the end of the government shutdown.

markets.question: Nordstrom Foot Traffic in November — Above 94.5
markets.rules:
If the Carbon Arc Nordstrom Foot Traffic (November 2026) for November 2026 is above 94.5, then the market resolves to Yes. For purposes of this market, determination will resolve on finalized Carbon Arc values recorded at 11:59 p.m. ET on the 7th calendar day after the end of the month covered by this market. For example, finalized Carbon Arc values for August will be recorded at 11:59 p.m. ET on September 7th.

The underlying is Carbon Arc's full-month year-over-year foot-traffic index for Nordstrom, based on mobile location data. An index value of 100 means visits equal the same month in the prior year. Values above 100 indicate growth and values below 100 indicate decline; for example, 103 means 3% more visits and 97 means 3% fewer visits than the same month in the prior year.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with Nordstrom. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

markets.rules:
